༄༅// 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ sar+b+bābud+dhānāṃdayadz+nyānālaṃnidhi/ rguh+yat+r+yāt+mamatwaṃmahāstuṣ+ṭoherukaḥ sam+ban+naṃkoṣoguṇobhadraṣ+yagraho/ bidz+nyānāyakyot+tarasmāyādh+yeṣaṇaḥ// ༄༅// sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// gsang ba gsum bdag dga' chen he ru ka /phun tshogs yon tan bzang po'i mdzod 'dzin pa// rnam mkhyen 'dren pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs// ༄༅// saṃmūkhrobh+ramas+yasar+b+bamalāḥprahīṇa/ sas+yānashrawash+tsatus+suratiprapuṣ+ṭ+wa/ mārgobhadrashāsanas+yarasongharīka sam+ban+naṃhitas+sukhas+yanamo3karāya/ shreyāñcatshubhaṃ.athopuṣ+ṭas+yā ༄༅// kun rmongs 'khrul pa'i bag chags kuṃn sangaṃs shing*// zag med dgaṃ' bzhi'i lo tog rab rgyaṃs nas// lam bzaṃng bstaṃn pa'i snying poṃ'i bcud 'dzin pa// phun tshogs phan bdeṃ'i 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal// dge legs bkraṃ shiṃs rgyas pa'i maramārge/ dz+nyān kṛpaunirābhogas+saṇ+ḍalabān+dhīḥ// bishwetakar+m+mabud+dhaḥkār+yaṃdashadik+ṣupra/ ādh+yeṣaṇaḥkumut+s+yashraiṇ+ṭhāyasubhabyaṃ// tabats+tsh+rad+dhātshan+datsānan+dadh+wadza.agre/ prawar+ṇaṇar+homaṅgalaṃbṛṣ+ṭais+sakaleṣ+ṭaḥ/ lha lam du// mkhyen brtse lhuṃn gruṃb blo gros dkyil 'khor can// rnam dkar phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa// skal bzang kun+da'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar dad 'dun kuṃn dgaṃ'i rgyal mtshan rtser// bsngags 'os bkraṃ shiṃs 'dod dgu'i gru char nirābhogepash+tsimañcāsauhitasaukhyaḥ sadāsaṃyats+tshāyatiṣ+ṭhan+tuhṛd pad+me/ mahāshāraṇ+yarat+nas+t+rayāṇāṃsat+yas+yā/ nubhāweṇārater+dhar+m+mabhadrāthodhāraḥ bhawan+tāpash+tsimesar+b+basatwānāṃwar+dho/ nirābhogaḥ gyis// 'di dang phyi mar phan bde lhuṃn gruṃb tu// rnam kun stsol phyir snying gi pad+mar bzhugs// skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus// kunaṃ dgaṃ'i ring lugs bzaṃng poṃ'i bkraṃshiṃs rgyun// mi nub srid mthar rgyas shing 'gro kun gyi// don gnyis lhuṃn

athomeprayats+tshan+tudh+yar+thaḥ it+yayaṃshrād+dhālushiṣ+yobahubhirtsoditas+yamukhāyāt+matwok+taṃ/ tathābadz+radharomaṅgalanirābhogestutisad+bhaṭ+ṭārakatatweṇakritabhoṭarutamastiṃ/ twayāsaṃskṛtas+yarutaṃbar+t+taya.iti/ nabapu gyis gruṃb pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni dad ldan gyi slob ma mang pos bskul ngor rang nyid kyis bgyis pa'o// de ltar rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub la bstod pa rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa bod skad du yod pa la/ khyod kyis legs par sbyar ba'i skad du sgyur cig ces gsar raṇausaṃketas+yagran+thadharakogurukar+m+mashrīsid+dheṇatsodanas+yamukhāya/ byākaraṇawādishīlarat+nanāmeṇa/ samabṛt+tādz+dzagatitsātidzagatayosh+tsatshan+denaban+dhitwa/ tsakasūtrebar+t+titas+sukal+yāṇaṃ rnying brda'i gzhung lugs 'dzin pa bla ma kar+m+ma dpal grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ brda sprod smra ba tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta las skye 'gro dang shin tu skye 'gro dag gi sdeb sbyor gyis bcings te/ 'khor lo mdor bsgyur bhawan+tu// //punaḥsenāshubhanirābhogot+tararādzagṛhād+dhar+m+madānāk+ṣayas+yadhāraprapañcas+yashubhenagutādhiṣ+ṭhānasar+b+basatwānāṃtan+t+rayawatāraṃbhawatu/ sarbamaṅgalaṃ// ba shin tu dge bar gyur cig slar yang sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab nas chos sbyin mi zad pa'i rgyun spel ba'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /thams cad bkra shis// thamaṃs cadaṃ mkhyeṃn paṃ dgyes bskyed tshul khrims kyi// dri ldan gang 'dul sku yi pad+ma ni// lhuṃn gruṃb chad med phrin las 'dab stong rdzogs// rgyal bstan skyed tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan la 'dud// dag gsal gsung gis 'gro blor 'tsham pa'i chos// ston tshe lung rigs gdams pa'i ngo mtshar gyis// dran dbang kun yid mgron du bos pa bzhin// smra mkhas bye ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// sngon sbyangs mthu stobs brgya byin sor mo yi// 'phrul gyis legs bris shes bya'i ri dwags gzugs// rnam gsal mkhyen rab zla ba rgyas pa yis// mkhas pa'i gnyis skyes dga' ba bskyed la 'dud// 'gro ba'i phung khams skye mched tha mal mtshang*// lha yi 'khor lor sgyur ba'i thabs mkhas la// ma rmongs gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje 'chang*// khyed la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dad pas gsol btab dge tshogs nyal 'gro mas// bdag rgyud dam tshig sa bon lus stobs bskyed// rim gnyis sdong bu sbom mthor sku bzhi'i 'bras// legs smin don gnyis dga' ston 'gyed par shog

/ces thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub la bstod pa byin rlabs zla gzugs 'char ba'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dam pa de nyid kyi bka' drin gyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i slob bu tshul khrims rin chen gyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// ༄// rdo rje 'dzin dbang nam mkha' bsam 'grub la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba// ༄༅// bi dza yan+tu/ dge legs yon tan mi zad naṃm mkhaṃ'i mdzod// dbang bsgyur 'chad rtsod rtsom pas gdul bya yi// bsaṃm kun 'gruṃb par byed pa'i phrin las mchog /lhun grub rgyun mi chad la gsol ba 'debs// bcas la nam yang skyon med dgra bcom che// mkha' khyab snying rjes dbang bsgyur rgyal ba'i sras// mthong thos dran bsam lha sngags ye shes su// mngon gyur grub pa'i dbang phyug zhabs brtan gsol// tshig 'dis gsol ba 'debs so cog rnams dus// nam yang tshul khrims dag pas mkha' khyab kyi// 'gro ba'i bsam don kun nas 'grub pa'i thabs// dam chos rin chen sgron me sbor bar shog /ces pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i zhabs stegs mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin dbang nam mkha' bsam 'grub la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang blo'i zhing sar 'dun pa'i sa bon gyis sbrum pa'i khar/ dad ldan gyi slob ma bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi bskul tshig drod gsher gyi rkyen 'dzom pa la brten/ snyan dngags smra ba'i dge slong tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por bris pa'i dge bas 'gro ba'i rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug srid pa las// 'gro ba gdon phyir skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'jig rten kuṃn du dgaṃ' ba'i lam ston la// zla bral phrin las lhuṃn gyis gruṃb la 'dud// tshogs gnyis stobs su bdo ba'i 'dab brgya pa// smon lam yid 'phrog dga' ma'i 'gram chang gis// legs phye tshul khrims dag pa'i ba ku la// mdo rgyud thos pa'i ge sar ci yang rdzogs// sde snod gsum gyis brjod bya'i snying po dag

/sdom pa gsum gyi ris su legs bsdus nas// rigs can gsum la skal bzhin 'doms pa la// 'jig rten gsum na mkhas pa'i mchog tu khums// mtha' klas shes byar ma thogs mkhyen pa'i mtshar// dran dbang khyod dang dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs// skal ba dman pas snang dang snang min las// gzhan pa'i khyad par bskal par dmigs su med// sna tshogs yid kyi shing rta phyogs kun nas// gdengs pa 'dod pa de dang des 'gengs kyang*// mchog gi 'bras bus dben phyir yongs 'du'i shing*// yon tan phung po khyod las yong ye dman// chos la mkhas pa'i las byas drin che yang*// smra mchog rgyal ba'i phrin las skyong rnams kyi// las 'di yin phyir ched du ci ste bsngags// kun dga' lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs// tshul 'dis bsngags pa'i rgyud mangs 'khrol byed pa// de ni dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma yis// kun du dga' gcugs grogs ltar rjes bzung nas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la bsngags pa rin chen rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa'i legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyi skal ba mi dman par gyur pa'i slob 'bangs tshul khrims rin chen gyis gus par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin la bstod pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs sprul rgyal ba'i sras// 'gro kuṃn dgaṃ' bder 'god pa'i bsam sbyor dang*// kun mkhyen bstanaṃ pa'i bshad sgrub lhur len pa// ngur smrig 'dziṃn mchog nyin mor byed la 'dud// mtha' yas rgyud sde'i rin chen 'byung gnas las// smin grol gdams pa'i nor bu yongs blangs te// kuṃn la legs 'doms 'dod dgu'i dga' ston gyis// bstaṃn 'dziṃn slob bus sa stengs brgyan la 'dud// skyabs gsum 'dus zhal bstod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// yang srid kun du dal 'byor rdzogs pa'i rten// dam pas rjes bzung lnga rig 'od stong 'bar// rgyal gsung pad+ma rab tu rgyas byed shog

/ces rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin la bstod pa byin rlabs 'dod dgu char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsi mnos pa'i bu slob tshul khrims rin chen gyis dad pa'i shugs 'byung du na mang sna'i rgya mkhar thang du sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos 'dren pa mchog rnams kyis// rnam gsum sdom pa'i bkraṃ shiṃs cho gar brten// dbaṃng phyugaṃ brgyad ldan gdung 'tshob mnga' gsol nas// rgyal ba'i phrin las rjes su skyong la 'dud// lung dang rigs tshul bkraṃ shiṃs 'khor lo yis// shes bya'i nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor yongs bcal nas// 'phags nor rin chen bdun la dbang 'byor ba// smra ba mkhas pa'i dbaṃng phyugaṃ la phyag 'tshal// de ltar bstod pa'i bkraṃ shiṃs g.yas 'khyil dung*// gang zhig brjod pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byin pa de// mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbaṃng phyugaṃ bla ma yis// byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes gzung gsol// zhes 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dbang phyug la bstod pa bkra shis g.yas 'khyil zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi mos gus kyi khar dbon kun dga' chos 'phel gyis bskul 'phral ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa'o// // ༄༅// rdo rje 'dzin dbang bkra shis bzang po la bsngags pa byin rlabs sbrang rtsi len pa'i mgrin rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ tshogs gnyis zung du chud pa'i sa bon las// legs 'khrungs 'jig rten dge ba'i bkraṃ shiṃs dung*// gsang gsum yon tan 'khyil pa'i khong yangs nas// bzaṃng poṃ'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad la 'dud// dge mtshan bkraṃ shiṃs ri mo rdzogs pa'i sku// tshul khrims dag pa'i dri bzaṃng phung poṃ yis// 'jig rten phyag 'os bsgrubs nas thos bsam dang*// bsgoms pas shes bya ma lus gzigs la 'dud// kun rdzob brda dang don dam bsgoms byung gi

/byang chub sems kyis rgyud 'byongs rgyal ba'i sras// snying rjes legs bskul gzhan don bkraṃ shiṃs kyi// 'khor los sgyur ba bzaṃng poṃ'i phul la 'dud// bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor los bkraṃ shiṃs glu// snyan par blangs te sku bzhi'i rgyal srid la// dbang gi mnga' gsol lam bzangaṃ rdo rje'i theg /smra dbang rigs brgya'i mgonaṃ po la phyag 'tshal// de ltar bstod pa'i legs byas 'dzam bu'i 'bras// mkhyen brtse nus mtshor 'dres pa'i byang chen gyi// mdog bzang phung po bdag thob sems can la// chos lam 'dod dgu'i sbyin chen 'gyed par shog /ces pa rdo rje 'dzin dbang bkra shis bzang po la bsngags pa byin rlabs sbrang rtsi len pa'i mgrin rnga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bdag sems kyi bung ba gzhon nu 'dun pa'i 'dab ma bsgyur 'dod yod pa'i khar/ mkhyen yangs bla ma tshul khrims don grub kyi gsung bskul pad+ma'i dri bsung snying la sim par brten/ bstod yul dam pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsi nod pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// dge legs bkraṃ shiṃs phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas// lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bzaṃng poṃ'i mdzod// skal ldan 'gro ba smin pa'i rtsa lag tu// gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams su brtan bzhugs gsol// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i zer phreng gis// 'jig rten phan bde mi zad chu yi gter// rgya cher 'phel ba'i skyabs gcig kun+da'i gnyen// brtan par bzhugs nas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// yul dam pa bkra shis bzang por zhabs brtan du mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong zhal snga nas sh+lau ka gcig mdzad pa'i kha 'gengs 'di ni tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag na dus gsum du// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i dpaṃl ldaṃn stobs bcu pa// kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i zlos gar gyis// lung rtogs choṃs kyi rgyal srid skyoṃng la 'dud// grangs med bskal par bsags pa'i legs byas mtsho// smon lam rjes su dran pa'i sa 'dzin gyis// bsrubs pa las 'khrungs sku yi zla ba gang*// thub bstan bde 'byung ral par mdzes la 'dud// 'jam dpal gzhon nus yangs par phye ba'i mgrin// gang las bab pa'i gdangs dang bsres pa'i chos// skal ba ji bzhin 'doms pas gdul bya yi// mos pa'i shing rta phyur bur 'gengs la 'dud// ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i khengs pa dag

/bstungs pa'i min par thugs su chud pa mtshar// 'on te thams cad gzigs pas ma gzhal ba'i// chos 'ga' med pa'i nges pa rnyed la 'dud// lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i don// gzigs pa tsam gyis ded dpon mchog gi rjes// bsngags pa min yang dad can srid mtsho las// sgrol ba'i thabs mkhas ldan pa 'dis kyang ngo*// srid par ltar snang bde ba'i myos chu la// sred ldan gdul dka'i sems kyi glang po dag /thar pa'i phan yon lcags kyus legs btab nas// bag yod tshul khrims rwa bar 'jug la 'dud// skyob pa kun gyis bgrod pa'i lam po che// gzhan don byang chub smon dang 'jug sems gyis// rgyal ba'i myu gu grangs med bskyed pa'i phul// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i gter la 'dud// rgyud sde kun gyis bstan bya thabs lam gyi// rtsa ba dbang bskur rgyud bshad gdams ngag gis// skal ldan sgrib pa sbyong dang lhan cig tu// sangs rgyas sa bon legs par 'jog la 'dud// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phrin las nam mkha'i mthar// song ba 'di yis bsti gnas phrogs so zhes// 'dod lhas rang gi rags lus bsregs pa snyam// khyed la 'dud do rtag tu zhabs brtan gsol// dpaṃl dang ldaṃn pa'i sangs rgyas des gsungs choṃs// bstan skyoṃng dge 'dun bcas pa khyod las gzhan// dmigs su med pa'i phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i sprin// mngon par spro zhing sdig ltung mthol bar bgyi// 'gro ba'i bsod nams rjes su dga' ba bskyed// smra mchog chos sgra 'byin par bskul ba dang*// mya ngan mi 'da'i gsol 'debs snyan pa'i glur// blangs pa'i dge ba byang chub che phyir bsngo// zhing dang bsam pa brjod bya rjod byed rnams// dge ba'i shing rtas byin rlabs nyin mor byed// tshul 'dis bstod pa'i yid mkhar 'dren bgyid cing*// rnam grol phyogs kyi snang ba rgyas par shog /gang de mngon du gyur min de srid kyi// skye ba'i phreng bar dal 'byor lus thob nas// bslab gsum rnam dag phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung*// yongs 'dzin bstan pa'i nyi mar bdag gyur cig

/ces pa rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i zhabs stegs chos kyi khri la mnga' gsol ba'i rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chen po dpal ldan chos skyong la bstod pa byin rlabs nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bdag sems kyi khyung sngon skyes de mchog tu 'dun pa'i lam nas 'di ltar rtsom pa'i kha lo bsgyur du nye bar mchis pa'i khar/ dad pa'i nor can dkon mchog dpal ldan la sogs pa'i bu slob 'ga' zhig gi bskul tshig dri bzhon gyi pho nya dag gis kyang nye bar son pa la brten nas/ bstod yul dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i skal ba mi dman par gyur pa'i snyan dngags smra ba tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas dad pa'i sems kyis kun nas bslangs te sbyar ba dge legs shin tu 'phel bar gyur cig// / ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma kun dga' dpal 'byor la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// legs byas kunaṃ nas bsags pa'i chu gter las// legs 'khrungs ris med gdul bya kun+da'i gnyen// legs bshad 'od kyis mkhas mang gnyis skyes tshogs// legs par dgaṃ' bskyed dpaṃl 'byoṃr bzang por 'dud// rgyal kun gsung rab srid do cog gi don// thos bsam bsgom pas legs sbyangs mthar phyin nas// chos tshul zab mo 'gro la ston mkhas rjer// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol btab mthu dang dus gsum dges// skye kun rgyal ba'i ring lugs dri med sgor// legs zhugs khrims ldan mchog gi lus thob nas// smin grol lam gyi nyams len mthar phyin shog /ces dpal ldan bla ma kun dga' dpal 'byor la bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ slob 'bangs tha chung kun dga'

tshul khrims rin chen no// bsod nams kyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༄༅// dpal sa skya pa ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' blo gros la bsngags pa sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// lha mchog ngag gi dbang phyug srid pa 'dir// skal bzang kuṃn du dgaṃ' bskyed bshes gnyen tshul// legs par bshad pa'i 'byung gnas bloṃ groṃs bzang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snang byed la phyag 'tshal// ngo mtshar dpal mgur yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// rin chen rgyud mangs sbreng ba'i mtsho byung ma// 'gro khams ji bzhin mtha' klas chos ma lus// kuṃn dgaṃ'i snyan dngags glu ru len pa snyam// zab dang rgya che shes bya'i yul kun la// legs sbyangs so sor skyes dang 'phags tshogs kyi// bloṃ groṃs mtha' dag khyod thugs yangs pa'i klong*// gcig tu dog bral tshul du spungs pa bzhin// rmad byung thugs rje ris su bral ba dang*// rnam dkar mdzad pa'i pha rol dpag dka' ba// grags pa'i yi ges phyogs kun dog por byas// thub pa'i rgyal tshab bskal par zhabs brtan gsol// de ltar bstod byed byang chub mchog la reg /de srid skye bar dal 'byor rten thob nas// phyi nang rig pa'i 'dab stong yongs bzhad pa'i// smra dbang nyin mo'i mgon por byin gyis rlobs// zhes dpal sa skya pa ngag gi dbang phyug kun dga' blo gros la bsngags pa sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi mos 'dun gyi khar dad pa'i nor can kun dga' stobs ldan dang rin chen chos 'dzin dag gis bskul bas rkyen byas te/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas aṅgi ra'i lor zla ba gro bzhin 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du bris pa dge'o// // ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal la bsngags pa bsod nams dpag bsam zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal ba'i phrin las sgyu 'phrul kaṃrmaṃ pa'i// lugs mchog 'chiṃ meṃd lam yangs mdzes pa'i rgyan// thubaṃ bstaṃn nyin mo'i snang ba raṃb gsal byed// lnga rig smra ba'i nyi ma de la 'dud// sde snod gsum gyi rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i bcud// sdom gsum 'chiṃ meṃd btung bas bskyed bsrings pa'i// thubaṃ bstaṃn legs bris rgyal srid skyong ba'i lha// gzhung mang mkhyen pa'i mig stong raṃb tu gsaṃl// dbyangs kyi rgyal mos legs phye mgrin pa las// shar lho'i lam dang sgra don gab tshig rgyan// nyer 'phos zab dang rgya che'i legs bshad kyis// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re skong mchog tu khums// gzhung lugs thos bsam bsgoms byung shes rab kyis// dpyad pa'i g.yar lam brtan pa ma btang ba'i// zab yangs shes bya'i dngos de gang du mchis// 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo mchog de la 'dud// khyed la cung zad bstod pa'i nus pas bdag

/byang chub snying po'i bar gyi tshe rabs phreng*// gtsug lag yongs 'dzin dam pa'i rjes bsgrub cing*// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi mar byin gyis rlobs// zhes dpal ldan bla ma karma 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal la bsngags pa bsod nams dpag bsam zhes bya ba 'di ni rang gi mos 'dun gyi sa bon mchis pa'i khar dge slong ye shes dpal ldan pa'i gsung bskul drod gsher gyi rkyen 'dzom par brten/ bka'i slob 'bangs ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis gus par sbyar ba sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang la bsngags pa byin rlabs rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rnam mkhyen sangaṃs rgyaṃs yongs kyi brgya phrag rigs// kun la dbang bsgyur dpaṃl mchog snyems ma'i bdag /'gro ba'i don dgongs ngur smrig zol sbyor gyis// gang 'tsham lam bzaṃng ston pa de la 'dud// srid bde lha min g.yo sgyus ma tshugs par// sdom gsum chu bo yongs bzhes smin grol klung*// 'gro mang yid kyi 'dzin char 'bebs brtson pa'i// 'jam dpal grub pa'i drang srong mchog la bstod// de ltar bstod pa'i byin rlabs pho nya yis// bdag sogs shes rgyud 'gron po yongs bskul nas// dam tshig khur gyis ngal med rim gnyis gom// legs bsgyur sku bzhi zung 'jug grong bgrod shog /ces mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang la bsngags pa byin rlabs rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni rang nyid kyi mos 'dun dang dge slong kun dga' tshe brtan pa'i gsung gis bskul ba lhan cig 'dzom par legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba pa'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du sug bris su bgyis pa'o// maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sangs rgyas ye shes la bsngags pa ye shes gzigs pa 'gugs pa'i gling bu zhes bya ba zhugs//

༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ mkha' mnyam rdul snyed zhing gi 'jig rten na// byon dang 'byon 'gyur bzhugs pa'i sangaṃs rgyaṃs kyi// yeṃ sheṃs gcig tu bsdus pa'i mig 'phrul gyis// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// bla ma lha yi byin rlabs mtshar sdug gi /rkang rtses bsnun pa'i blo gros a sho kaḥ// rnam par phye ba'i 'bras bu 'chad rtsod dang*// legs bshad rtsom pa'i dri bsung 'thul la 'dud// gzhan don bla na med pa'i byang chub che// smon dang 'jug pa'i sdom pa legs bzung nas// gtong phod chen po'i mgrin pa brkyangs nas ni// 'gro la chos kyi sbyin chen gtong la 'dud// dngos dang brgyud pa'i zhal gyi 'chi med mdzod// rnam par phye ba las byung dbang bskur dang*// rgyud bshad gdams pa'i bdud rtsi kun gyi gter// 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma zhabs brtan gsol// gsang gsum yon tan brjod pa'i gling bu 'di// gang dag dad pa'i sor mos bskul ba de'i// rgyud la sangaṃs rgyaṃs kun dngos bla ma yi// yeṃ sheṃs gzigs pa'i 'bab stegs byed par shog /ces pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sangs rgyas ye shes sam 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma dbyangs can dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhes yongs su grags pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan la bsngags pa ye shes gzigs pa 'gugs pa'i gling bu zhes bya ba 'di yang rang gi yid las skyes pa'i mos gus kyi mdza' bos yang yang bskul ba'i khar/ zol med dad pa'i nor can dge slong bkra shis dpal bzang gis bskul bas kyang rkyen byas te/ bstod yul dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi len pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// mkhas btsun grub pa nam mkha' dpal bzang la bstod pa dge legs dbyar dus 'gugs pa'i pho nya bzhugs//

༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ dpag ldan pa'i gzugs can/ yas tshogs gnyis naṃm mkhaṃ' yangs pa'i ngos// mkhas btsun grub pa'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las// mkhyen brtse nus dpaṃl mi zad char rgyun gyis// dge legs dbyar gyi skal bzaṃng bsu la 'dud// phyi ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ tshul bag yod bslab/ bzhi'i rwa bar gnas// nang du stong nyid snying rjes gzhan don spyod// gsang bar zung 'jug sku bzhi'i grong mchog tu// bde bar son pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi mdzod// chu bsngags pa'i dpe/ gter namaṃ mkhaṃ'i nor bu 'byin pa'i ma// dbang gi rgyal po dpaṃl 'byor 'byung ba'i gnas// de dag nyid dang 'dren pa bzaṃng po khyod// sems can phan pa'i gzhir gyur mtshungs par bsngags// naṃm ngag don gyi dpe/ mkha'i nor bzhin thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor can// snang ba'i dpaṃl bzhin rnam dkar phrin las gter// 'dab brgya pas bzhin lam bzaṃng don gnyer tshogs// gus pas bsten cing rtag tu zhabs brtan gsol// skyabs yongs brjes la gzugs can gyis sba ba/ gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid khyod bstod pas// byang chub bar gyi skye bar dal 'byor rten// tshul khrims nor bu mdzes shing stobs bcu pa'i// chos tshul smra ba'i nyi mar bdag byin rlobs// zhes pa mkhas btsun grub pa nam mkha' dpal bzang la bstod pa dge legs dbyar dus 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsi len pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis shis pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs ched rnam byung gi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bzhi lang tsho'i sbyor ba 'dzom pa'i nyin/ lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// rgyal ba kun bdag rdo rje 'chang ba nyid// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob kuṃn dgaṃ'i lam zhugs nas// rgyal tshab bzaṃng poṃ'i phrin las dpag yas kyis// rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad la 'dud// dpaṃl ldaṃn rdo rje sems dpa' bskal sngon gyi// smon lam dag pa'i dpyangs thag la 'khyud de// choṃs mig rab yangs dge ba'i bshes zlos pas// thub pa'i phrin las legs par skyoṃng la 'dud// ngag gi dbang phyug byin rlabs zil mngar rgyun// 'thungs pa'i blo gros lang tsho dar babs lus// tshuṃl khriṃms la sogs thos pa'i rgyan dang ldan// legs bshad riṃn cheṃn rgyud mangs 'khrol la 'dud// skyabs mchog kun 'dus 'dren pa gsum po la// cung zad bstod byas byin rlabs dgung char rgyun// gus ldan sgo gsum zhing sar rab sim nas// don gnyis phun tshogs snye mas dud par mdzod// gang du skyes pa'i lus rten pad+ma'i phreng*// dal dang 'byor tshogs 'dab ma rdzogs pa'i nang*// blo gros bung ba thos bsam bcud myos pa'i// bshad sgrub mgrin glu rtag tu len par shog

/skyabs gsum bla mar bsngags pa'i tshig /me tog gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan 'di// nyer gnas gsar bus bskul ba'i ngor// tshul khrims rin chen zhes byas bris// // ༄༅// skyabs mchog rnam pa gnyis la bstod pa 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /don kun grub pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa yi// zhal las 'ongs pa'i chos kyi bkraṃ shiṃs dbyangs// ji snyed 'gro la 'doms pa'i phrin las dag /lhuṃn gruṃb rgyun mi chad pa de la 'dud// sangaṃs rgyaṃs kun gyi gsang gsum yon tan stsal// yongs su rdzogs pa'i gar gyi mtshan rtog las// yid rab skyob pa'i bstaṃn paṃ yongs kyi rtse// smra ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan de la 'dud// byang chub bar gyi lam mkhan sgron ma mchog /zung gi yon tan ri mo yid kyi ngos// bris nas bstod pa'i bsod nams gang dag gis// don gnyis dpal gyis 'byor pa bdag gyur cig /ces mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub pa dang grub dbang sangs rgyas bstan pa ste/ skyabs mchog rnam pa gnyis la bstod pa 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ dus mchod skabs kyi gdon byar 'di bzhin dgos zhes/ mkhyen yangs bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor pa'i gsung gis bskul bar brten/ rje btsun dam pa'i bran du gyur pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// chos kyi rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bstod pa dpyod ldan rna bar 'jebs pa'i gling bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ rgya che ba bsam pa rgya che ba la yan lag gcig gzugs kyis mdzes pa'i rab spel/ dang zab pa'i tshogs zung gis// mngon par bskrun pa'i dpal gyis ches mtho yang*// kuṃn dgaṃ'i dpal ster sdom brtson bshes gnyen gyi// rnam pas bstan pa'i rgyaṃl mtshaṃn 'dzin la 'dud// 'dul ba mtha' dag gi gzugs can sngon byung gtam las drangs pa/

mdo dang gsang rgyud rgya mtsho yi// snying po sdom pa gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// legs par bzung nas 'gro ba'i nyon mongs rims// zhi mdzad chos kyi sman pa zhabs brtan gsol// mkhas bzhi ka'i thog mar mchis pa'i chod pa'i zung ldan/ btsun dam pa'i drin gyis skye ba'i phreng*// mkhas mchog rgyal ba'i rjes su bdag slob cing*// mkhas dang btsun dang bzang po'i rtser 'dzegs nas// mkhas pa'i bya bar dbang bar byin gyis rlobs// ces pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i phrin las kyi kha lo pa chos kyi rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bstod pa dpyod ldan rna bar 'jebs pa'i gling bu zhes bya ba 'di yang dad ldan gyi slob bu dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis bskul ba dang*/ rang nyid kyang mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan zad mi shes pas yid yongs su drangs pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa la brten nas/ snyan dngags mkhan tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rnam rgyal la bsngags pa dad pa'i chu 'phel zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ dge legs 'byung gnas dkon mchog rnam pa gsum// gcig bsdus kuṃn dgaṃ'i dpal ster bshes gnyen gyi// rnamaṃ pas rgyalaṃ ba'i gsung rab ma lus bcud// yongs su bzung nas legs par 'doms la 'dud// gzhung mang thos bsam bsgom pa'i ge sar gyis// mngon par lci ba'i sdom brtson pad+ma dkar// kuṃn dgaṃ' skyed pa'i zhi dul 'dab ma can// nyes pa'i dgra las rnam par rgyaṃl la 'dud// rgyu 'bras bslu med mkhyen pa mkhas pa'i rab// bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' btsun pa'i mchog /byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs bzang po'i phul// ma 'dris 'gro ba kun gyi bshes la 'dud// brtse chen kuṃn dgaṃ'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan// bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya bas skyong ba la// kun las rnamaṃ par rgyaṃl ba'i phrin las can// gsang chen bstan pa'i dpyid du zhabs brtan gsol// de ltar bstod pa'i dge bas bdag rgyud la// bslab bzhi'i chu gter 'phel ba las byung ba'i// lung rtogs yon tan rdzogs pa'i nor bu yis// 'gro ba kun gyi re ba bskang bar shog

/ces pa khams ston rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' rnam rgyal la bsngags pa dad pa'i chu 'phel zla ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid la 'dun pa mchis khar blo dang dad pa'i nor can sangs rgyas rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i rkyen byas te/ dam tshig bdud rtsis bran pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel/// / ༄༅// mkhas btsun chos kyi rje bsod nams blo gros par bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sgyu 'phrul ngur smrig 'chang*// bsoṃd namaṃs 'bras bu yongs smin skyes sbyangs kyi// bloṃ groṃs dar bab rgyal ba'i sras la 'dud// rnam dkar mdzad pa'i mchog sbyin brkyangs pa las// chos tshul 'dod dgu'i dga' ston rtag 'jo ba// dpag yas yon tan rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas// 'gro ba'i re skong mchog tu brtan bzhugs gsol// su zhig bstod pa'i bsoṃd naṃms dpag bsam shing*// bloṃ groṃs spobs pa'i yal 'dab rgyas pa las// mkhas tshul gsum gyi ci 'dod gtong ba yis// bstan dang sems can phan pa'i gsos gyur cig /ces mkhas btsun chos kyi rje bsod nams blo gros par bsngags pa byin rlabs 'dod pa 'jo ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thub pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i bgo skal nod pa'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas dngos po'i gnam lor lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu sbyar ba sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// gzhung lugs smra ba'i rab 'byams pa dge 'dun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la bstod pa yon tan ut+pal btus pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ don gnyis

ldan pa'i gzugs kyis spud pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas dang*// lung rtogs chos dang 'phags pa'i daṃge 'duṃn bcas// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rin po che// bstaṃn paṃ'i rgyaṃl mtshaṃn mdzes pa'i rgyan la 'dud// grangs sngon byung gi gtam dang sbyar ba'i mtha' dag gzugs can/ med skye ba'i bsod nams lag pa yis// legs bris mi mthun med pa'i mtshan ris can// gzhan don skye bar zlos pa'i zla ba las// phan bde'i snang ba 'dzad pa med pa'i dpyid// sems can ting nge 'dzin gyi rab brtag khams su smin pa'i nyon mongs snying*// 'bigs byed gnyen po nyid du rno ba'i chos// 'dren pa'i shing rta de ni nga nyid ces// khyod gsung yan lag drug cus 'bod pa bzhin// ring nas thos bsam bsgom pas sbyangs pa'i blo// yangs pa'i pha rol zhig tu lus pa'i chos// 'ga' yang med pa kun gyi de bzhin nyid// gzigs pa'i tha gru nam mkhas mtshon du med// the tshom 'gog pa/ skye dgu'i re ba rdzogs byed gang yin de// dpag bsam rkang 'thung nyid dam khyod kyi mthu// 'on te mchog gi 'bras bu ster ba'i phyir// dam pa'i yon tan nges pa'i spobs pa thob// yid khyad par dang ldan pa'i gzugs can/ ches lung dang dngos stobs rigs pa'i mtshon// reg bya rno ba'i so ldan 'phyar ba na// brdeg dang khro ba'i glan glan dogs pa med// mang thos skyes bu'i dga' ba'i rgyu yin no// sde snod bya ba brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed/ gsum dang rgyud bzhis bstan bya ba// rnam gsum sdom pa'i lam chen bzung nas ni// 'gro ba rang rang mos pa rjes mthun du// tshul bzhin 'doms pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung*// yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rdul rnyed kyis// yongs bzung dga' ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni// brtan byed cho ga rdzogs pa'i phrin las can// khyod la 'dud do bskal par zhabs brtan gsol//

rab spel gyi rgyan/ mchog gi yon tan ut+pal btus pa'i phreng*// su zhig mgrin pa'i rgyan du len pa dag /lta bsgom spyod pa dag pa'i byang chub lam// mtha' ru phyin pa'i snying po mngon gyur shog /ces gzhung lugs smra ba'i rab 'byams pa dge 'dun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la bstod pa yon tan ut+pal btus pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad pa'i nor bu snying la bcangs pa'i khyim bdag lha dbang mgon po la sogs pa'i slob bu 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor snyan dngags smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen du 'bod pas/ mig dmar du grags pa'i gsar tshes kyi gnam lor rgyu skar rta chen gyis nya pa'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du gus par sbyar ba shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam par rtsen pa ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang par bsngags pa byin rlabs dbyig gter 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// ngag gi dbang phyug gsang gsum yon tan gyi// chu gter bsrubs pa'i sgyu 'phrul nyin mor byed// gang 'tsham phrin las mu med snang ba'i dpal// skal bzang blo yi 'dab stong bzhad la 'dud// dpag yas shes byar grags pa'i khengs ldan de// khyod gcig thugs kar chud pa'i thub chod 'dis// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i myu gus mngon sprul pa'i// ji snyed gtsug lag nyung ngur byas kyi dogs// sgrib gnyis lha min nyer bcom drang srong gi /phyi nang rig pa'i chu klung yongs bzhes nas// dpyad gsum rnam dag legs bshad zil mngar rgyun// rnam 'dren bstan pa ring 'tsho'i gsos su 'gyed// chos gzugs sku yi yon tan gya nom la// dbang 'byor mchog gi go 'phang gnon bzod kyang*// deng dus 'gro blor 'tsham pa'i zlos gar gyis// theg gsum 'doms pa bskal par brtan bzhugs gsol// de skad bsngags pa'i lhas bstan shing rta yis// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i byin rlabs dbyig

/dad gsum khang par khugs pa'i chos 'byor gyi// bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gzhil mchog nyid gyur cig /ces mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam par rtsen pa ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang par bsngags pa byin rlabs dbyig gter 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid mos 'dun gyi sa bon bzung bar chos 'khor sa 'dzin bsod nams bkra shis pa'i bka' stsal drod gsher gyis bstsu bar brten/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed kyi gnam lo shar ba'i zla tshes dge bar bris pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa blo bzang dpal bzang bar bsngags pa dbyangs can rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ bloṃ chen bzaṃng po'i rnam thar tsan+dan dri// snying ga la sim dpaṃl stug bstan pa'i gzhi// chos 'dul bslab pas rab bsil dri bzaṃng gis// 'khor ba'i gdung 'phrog dgra bcom che la 'dud// bloṃ chen theg pa'i gzhung lugs mtshar sdug gi /rkang rtses bsnun pa'i snying stobs a sho kaḥ// gzhan phan ge sar bye ba'i rtse dga' dgod// kun bzaṃng rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob de la 'dud// dbang po rnor ldan 'jug ngogs rdo rje'i theg /snying po smin dang grol byed dpal kun gyis// skal bzang sku bzhi'i sa bon ci yang 'jog /gsang chen 'doms pa'i dbang phyug de la 'dud// bloṃ bzaṃng grags pa'i dpaṃl bstan mkha' dkyil nas// dkon mchog gsum 'dus bdag nyid zla ba nya// mkhas bzaṃng btsun pa'i 'od dkar 'bum phrag can// khyod la gsol 'debs bskal par zhabs brtan gsol// de skad bsngags pa'i dbyangs can tam+bu ra// dad gsum sor mos bskul ba'i dge bas bdag /byang chub bar gyi skye bar tshul khrims gtsang*// rgyal gsum smra ba'i nyi ma mchog gyur cig /ces dpal ldan bla ma dam pa blo bzang dpal bzang par bsngags pa dbyangs can rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/

mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes mchog nam mkha' brtan pa dang ngag dbang dpal bzang dag gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i dngos po'i gnam lo'i rgyal zla'i tshes bzang por ldan shod du gus pas sbyar ba sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// grub dbang bla ma pad+ma nor bu la bstod pa ut+pal phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dge tshogs shar ri'i phrag nas legs shar ba// thar mchog paṃd+maṃ'i 'dab stong bzhad pa'i dpal// skyabs kun 'dus pa nam mkha'i noraṃ buṃ las// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od stong 'phro la 'dud// ltar snang srid pa'i dga' bder ma chags par// bag yod tshul khrims bslab pas rgyud bsdoms nas// gzhan dag la yang legs par 'dom mdzad pa// dam pa'i chos 'dul smra ba'i mchog la 'dud// snying rjes shin tu mnyen par byas pa'i thugs// gzhan la phan phyir gzhol ba snying gi stobs// rgyal ba'i myu gu'i rnam thar rjes skyong ba// kun gyi mdza' bshes bla med gyur la 'dud// paṃd+mā ka ra'i zab gsang chu gter las// lung rtogs yon tan yid bzhin noṃr buṃ yis// rang gzhan don 'byor grub pa'i ded dpon khyod// 'pho bral zhabs zung bskal par brtan bzhugs gsol// paṃd+maṃ'i bcud 'thung bung ba'i glu bzhin du// gsang gsum yon tan cha shas ngas bstod pa'i// dge bas lung rtogs noraṃ buṃ zad mi shes// bdag gis thob nas sems can don byed shog /ces grub dbang bla ma pad+ma nor bu la bstod pa ut+pal phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di ni/ slob bu u rgyan rab dga'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la bstod pa dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// bi dza yan+tu/ skye ba'i phreng bar bsoṃd namaṃs 'du byas pa'i// snying po mchog gi bshes gnyen rnam rol gyis// 'gro tshogs don gnyis lhunaṃ gyis grubaṃ pa'i gnas// 'khrid byed thabs kyi khur chen khyer la 'dud// rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs// gsang gsum dri med shel gyi rtsig logs su// 'phos pa'i ngo mtshar skal bzang 'dren byed du// snang mdzad skyabs kyi dam pa zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs bla ma la// bstod pas mgrin pa'i 'khor lor brgyan pa de// zung gi dngos grub 'dod pa rtag 'jo bas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes rje btsun e waṃ pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid chen por mnga' gsol ba'i mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la bstod pa dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bka' 'bangs sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi ngor/ btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas gus par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// oṃ na maḥ.a mo gha sid+dhā ya/ gang zhig dad gsum ldan pa'i rtsig logs su// rtse gcig bsam gtan pir gyis bris tsam na// bsam kun bslu med ster ba dkon mchog gsum// smras don snye ma smin par byin gyis rlobs// phyogs bral rnam par 'dren pa sras dang bcas// ji snyed 'dus pa'i bdag nyid spruṃl pa'i sku// theṃg mchoṃg bstaṃn pa mkhas tshul dri med kyis// ring du brtan byed rdo rje 'dziṃn pa'i dbang*// deng 'dir sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam brten// mchog gi sprul sku'i skye ba'i zla gzhon gyis// bu slob kyis mtshon 'gro blo'i chu nang du// gzugs snang 'gog med ston pa'i dga' ston stsol// gang tshe lha mchog smra ba'i nyi ma yis// blo gros 'dab stong phye ba'i khong gseng nas// gtsug lag rab 'byams rkang drug glur 'jo bas// mang thos sgra 'dzin 'jebs pa'i dpal du sgrubs// dbang lung gdams ngag brgyud pas byin gyis brlabs// lhag pa'i lha mchog rnams kyis rjes su gzung*// bstan srung rgya mtshos bar chad kun bsal nas// bdag sogs gdul bya'i re ba yongs rdzogs mdzod// ces mchog gi sprul sku rin po che'i yang sprul myur byon gyi gsol 'debs zla gzhon 'dren pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rdzogs chen bla brang nas tshogs su gdon byar dgos tshul gyi bka' stsal phebs 'phral ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas ru dam gyi gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ bsam gyis mi khyab che ba'i yon tan gyis// rdo rje 'chang sa gnon pa'i rtsal rdzogs kyang*// sdom brtson mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam rol gyis// lus can byang chub smin mdzad khyod kyis srungs// rgyal kun ye shes chu gter bsrubs las skyes// mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon zlos pa'i zla// lung rtogs bstan pa'i dpal mgrin ral pa'i rtser// spud tshe dge legs zil mngar ci yang 'jo// khyad par pad+mā ka ra rang nyid kyi// bstan pa'i gsang mdzod 'dzin pa mngon sprul nas// rgyal tshab chen po'i bgyi ba dpag yas kyis// chos kyi snang byed gyur pa la phyag 'tshal// gya nom yon tan 'dzad bral skye dgu yi// re ba 'gengs pa'i dbang phyug mgon khyod la// mchod pa'i yo byad gyi nas phongs min yang*// bdag sogs bdog pa snying po blang bya'i phyir// stong 'khun yul gyi bzo bos btags pa'i dar// 'bral med dam tshig gtso bo rdo rje dril// mdog bzang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal gyis mtshon pa'i// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// 'khor bar yong 'byung sdig ltung dri ma'i tshogs// gnyen po stobs bzhi rdzogs pa'i chu bos 'khrud// skye 'phags bsod nams stug po'i sprin rums na// yid kyi mdongs mtha' kun dga'i 'dren byed blta// bskal mang bsod nams tshogs bskrun gzugs kyi sku// tshur mthong 'dren byed yul las rnam bskal pa'i// tshul 'dis rgyal ba'i sras kyi g.yar dam ni// ya ma brlar snyam nyid du ma byas grang*// gcig tu skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i nyin mor byed// rnam kun mchog bde'i gling gzhan mkhar bgrod tshe// rang gis gdul skal yod pa'i 'dab stong tshal// mi shes mun nang 'thums pa bzod lags grang*// gang phyir 'gro tshogs srid las gdon phyir du// zab yangs chos dbyings bde bar ma zhan par// dbang bcu ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'gog med phyir// la gor skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul spyon cig gu// mtsho ldan mgrin par rtsen pa'i skye ba yis// mdo sngags bzhed tshul ma 'dres snyan ngag lam// 'dren pas mchog dman bar ma'i blo can rnams// gang 'tsham dga' ston mgron du gnyer yang 'tshal// 'dis mtshon dge tshogs lho phyogs nags kyi rlung*// srid pa'i thang 'khyams lus can don mthun rnams// sdug bsngal kun 'byung gdung ba ring bcil nas// rnam mkhyen thar pa'i grong mchog 'jug rgyur bsngo// zhes pa 'di ni rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che theg mchog bstan 'dzin pa thugs chos dbyings zab mor mnyam par gzhag pa'i sku gdung la mchod 'bul gyi yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu//

// ༄༅// mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mkhas btsun blo bzang rnam rgyal la bsngags pa bskal bzang gzhon nu'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal gyi 'byung gnas rgyal kun ye shes kyi// sgyu 'phrul blo gros che mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs// skal bzang dge ba'i bshes su rnam rol pas// rgyal bstan dri med 'dzin pa de la 'dud// nges 'byung tshul khrims bslab par gus pa'i blo// yid srubs sprul pa'i dpal brgyar ma chags shing*// dka' spyad bslab gzhi bstan pas ma bzlog par// chos 'dul 'dzin pa'i spobs pa khyod la rdzogs// bla med byang chub 'dod pa'i g.yar dam gang*// bdag don gces 'dzin bloṃ yis dbrog tu med// gang phyir skal bzaṃng khyod kyi rnaṃm par thar// rgyalaṃba'i sras chen sbyor ba'i rjes su snyeg /mtha' klas sems can mos par 'tsham pa'i chos// ci 'dod legs par 'jo 'di khyod gcig dbyangs// ma yin rgyal ba kun gsung gsang ba'i dpal// mtha' dag ma byin blangs pa nyid du khums// thos bsam bsgom pa'i byed pos legs brdar ba'i// mkhyen rab nor bu'i rtsig par lung rtogs kyi// yon tan bden bral gzugs brgya rnam bkra ba// blo ldan añja na bu'i mig gi dpyid// rnam dkar phrin las phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i khongs// mda' lnga'i bdag pos bsti gnas ma rnyed par// lus rten 'dren byed zhugs su sbyangs sam snyam// mkhas tshul skyong ba bskal par zhabs brtan gsol// bsngags brjod byin rlabs yid 'phrog zur mig gis// lung rtogs yon tan skal bzang gzhon nu de// bdag rgyud khab tu khugs pas rang gzhan gyi// don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /ces mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mkhas btsun blo bzang rnam rgyal la bsngags pa skal bzang gzhon nu'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bsngags 'os dam pa'i yon tan pad+ma'i bsung zhim gyis// yid kyi rkang drug gzhon nu bskul ba'i tshe// gus ldan pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'tsho byung dgyes pa'i tshig sbyor gyi dbyangs chung glur blangs pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// chos smra ba'i btsun pa rin chen mtha' can la bsngags pa gus ldan ku mud dga' ba'i zla zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na ma wā gī shwa rā ya/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal gyi lung*// ji snyed smra ba'i dbang phyug las byung ba'i// tshuṃl khriṃms bslab pa riṃn cheṃn lta bu yis// 'jig rten mchod pa'i 'os su gyur la 'dud// rgyal sras mkhas pa rnams kyi 'jug pa'i sgo// shes par bya ba rig pa'i thos bsam las// byung ba'i rnam par dpyod pa'i spu sdug mig /chos spyod dge ba'i sprin rum gtod la 'dud// dman las che ba bdun ldan theg pa'i bcud// smon 'jug sdom pas rgyal ba'i sras kyi rigs// yongs bzung stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid kyi// sems ldan 'gro ba'i bshes su gyur la 'dud// gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal srid chen po la// rigs kyi cod paṇa 'dzin par mnga' gsol nas// dbang dang gdams ngag legs par 'doms pa yi// phrin las dam pa'i 'khor los sgyur la 'dud// nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims rtsa ba brtan// dge chos 'dzin pa'i yal 'dab ring rkyong ba'i// sems can don byed sku yi dpag bsam dbang*// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i tshal du mdzes la 'dud// rjod par byed pa rgyan dang 'brel pa yis// brjod bya'i don kun rnam par bshad pa'i tshe// sna tshogs 'gro ba'i yid nas bzung ba bzhin// mkhas pa'i bgyi ba rnam gsum skyong la 'dud// rnam dpyod me long la chags sgrib pa'i dri// thos bsam bsgom pa'i byed pos bdar ba'i nang*// phyi nang rig pa'i gzugs brnyan bkra ba yi// dpyod pa'i mig ldan dga' ba bskyed la 'dud// shes byar sbyangs pa'i tha snyad ngag gi dbang*// 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha// dbyangs can snyems pa'i gtam gyi lang tsho'i sder// 'bod par skyabs kyi dam pas bsngags la 'dud// lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med bla ma rnams// dgyes pa'i byin rlabs las byung legs pa yi// yon tan snang ba las brten phrin las kyis// 'gro ba'i re ba skong khyod zhabs brtan gsol// dkon mchog gsum po khyod las logs shig na// dmigs su med pa'i phyag 'tshal sngon 'gro mas// yid kyi bang mdzod phye ba las blangs pa'i// snang stong ya bral med pa'i mchod sprin 'bul// bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba// bshung zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bsdam pa dang*// 'phags dang so skyes bgyis pa'i dge tshogs la// yi rang 'dzum pa'i mdangs 'od dkar pos bran// chos rnga rnams las chos sgra 'byin pa dang*// zhi bde dben pa'i khang bur mi 'jug par// gsol 'debs gling bu snyan par bsgyur ba yi// dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub bsngo// de ltar bstod pa'i rten 'byung nus pas bdag

/skye nas skye bar sdom pa gsum gyi rgyun// gzhan don byang chub ched du legs bzung nas// phyogs bcur chos kyi rnga chen brdung bar shog /ces 'di bla ma mkhas btsun pa// sangs rgyas grags pa'i gsung gi mchid// rten dang bcas pas bskul ba'i ngor// tshul khrims rin chen rang las byung*// rang bstod 'ga' ni mdzes min yang*// 'don pa po la legs dgu yi// yon tan 'byung ba'i rten 'brel sogs// dgos skabs shes na rgyan du bsngags// // ༄༅// chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen la bsngags pa mos ldan mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje zlos pa'i gar// mkhas mchog mang po'i gsung las skyes pa'i bu// tshuṃl khriṃms la sogs rnam gsum bslab pa'i gnas// mang thos riṃn cheṃn snang ba 'phro la 'dud// 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa kun gyi ma// grangs med rgyal ba'i myu gus 'jug pa'i sgo// bcu phrag rig par sbyangs pa'i blo gros ni// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i lang tsho dar la 'dud// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i btung ba yis// brling bar byas pa'i snying stobs phrag pa na// 'gro tshogs srid las gdon pa'i g.yar dam gyi// khur chen 'degs pa rgyal ba'i sras la 'dud// blta dang dgod pa 'khyud dang zung sbyor gyi// kun nas dkris pa'i gnyen po rgyud sde bzhi'i// dbang bskur gdams pa'i chu bos skal ba can// sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud mdzad zhabs brtan shog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med bla ma la// bstod pas mgrin par brgyan pa de yi rgyud// tshuṃl khriṃms gsum dang lung rtogs yon tan rnams// riṃn cheṃn 'byung gnas bzhin du 'phel bar shog /ces pa chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen la bsngags pa mos ldan mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan phreng zhes bya ba 'di yang mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes gnyen bkra shis dpal bzang la sogs pa'i slob bu 'ga' zhig gis gsung nan chen pos bskul ngo ma bzlog tsam du/

sgro btags smra ba rang nyid kyis ji ltar nus pa'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs pa dang bcas te/ dpal sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// yang rang la bsngags pa// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las gdul bya'i ngor// tshulaṃ khriṃms phung po rdzogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bla ma'i mchog rnams las// riṃn cheṃn chos kyi snang ba thob la 'dud// dad dang tshulaṃ khriṃms rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes// gzhung mang thos bsam bsgom pa'i bcud kyis gtams// tshul bzhin 'gro la 'gyed pa'i sems bskyed kyi// riṃn cheṃn bum pa bzang por rtag brtan gsol// tshig 'dis bstod pa'i bsod nams rdzogs ldan sprin// gus ldan yid kyi mkha' dbyings dkrigs pa las// tshuṃl khriṃms dag cing bshad sgrub 'phel ba sogs// ci 'dod riṃn cheṃn char du 'bab par shog /de ltar bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni rang gis rang la bsngags par mi 'os kyang mos ldan gyi slob bu 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba ma bzlog tsam du bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi ba rang nyid kyis dmar po'i phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du 'phral la bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// oṃ swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ chos tshuṃl smra ba'i khriṃms ldan brtul zhugs 'chang*// riṃn cheṃn gsum tshogs 'dus pa'i bdag nyid khyod// 'gro la sman slad bskal par brtan bzhugs nas// byang chub sems mchog bdag rgyud bskyed du gsol// zhes pa 'di ni rab byung 'dod pa'i shing phag lo gsar tshes lnga'i nub mor miṃ re re sngon rjes su byung nas bdag la khyod kyi zhabs brtan gdon byar gnang dgos zer ba khas blangs ltar mi sngon ma de'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// mi de'i ming ma zin lags//

༄༅// oṃ swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ ngag gi dbang phyug byin rlabs nyi zer thigs// nyer lhung blo gros bdab brgya grol ba las// legs bshad tshulaṃ khriṃms dag pa'i bsung ltar ldang*// riṃn cheṃn pad+ma bzhad pa de la 'dud// tshulaṃ khriṃms bslab par slob pa'i 'phong skyen gyis// skyes sbyangs shes rab mda' gzhu'i 'khrul 'khor brten// shes bya'i gzugs dang gzugs brnyan dpyad pa'i gnad// yongs 'bigs dam pa'i dga' byed bskal par brtan// su zhig bstod nus snying la sim pa'i mod// dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can srid do 'tshal// tshe rabs pha mar shes pa'i byams brtse dang*// riṃn cheṃn sems gnyis rgyud la skye gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rab byung 'dod pa'i shing phag lo gsar tshes lnga'i nub mor rmi lam du mi re re sngon rjes su byung ste bdag la gdon byar khyod kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs shig dgos zer ba gnyis ka la khas blangs nas 'dri tshul byas te bsam mno cung zad btang ba'i skabs nas sad par phyi nyin nyung shas tsam las ma dran yang dgos pa zhig yod srid snyam nas kha 'gengs dang bcas bskul ba po phyi ma'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// rang la bstod pa ming spel me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma'i mchog rnams las// legs gsungs bdud rtsi 'thung skyes rgyal ba'i sras// tshuṃl khriṃms gsum gnas gtsug lag riṃn cheṃn mang*// yongs bzung smra ba'i dbang phyug de la 'dud// ye shes lnga bdag bde gshegs dga' mar bcas// byang chub sems dpa' lha mo bgegs kyi dgra// ma lus 'dus pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'dzin// tshul khrims rin chen gyis brgyan zhabs brtan shog /gang dag bstod pa'i rgyud mangs 'khrol byed pa// rtag tu tshulaṃ khriṃms bslab pas rgyud bsdoms nas// yon tan riṃn cheṃn rab 'bar snang ba yis// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog

/ces rang la bstod pa ming spel me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang mkhas btsun dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs/ nyi ma 'od zer/ kun dga' stobs ldan/ rin chen chos 'dzin sogs slob bu 'gas bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du bris pa dge legs 'phel par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// dpaṃl ldaṃn bla ma yi dam lha// choṃs skyoṃng nor sbyin 'dus pa'i bdag /skyabs mchog mkhyen brtse nus ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med pa// tshulaṃ khriṃms bslab ldan ngag gi dbang*// bla ma riṃn cheṃn lta bu la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs kun// 'khor ba ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyobs// 'gro la byams brtse byang chub sems// rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong dang tshul khrims rin chen dag la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni dpon mo tshe ring sgrol ma'i zhal ton du ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// rgyal ba ma pham pa dang mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis su med pa la bstod kyin gsol ba 'debs pa thugs rjer bskul ba'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ sgron ma'i bskal pa'i kun gsal lam yangs por// chos kyi snang byed byon dang 'byon 'gyur gyi// kun mkhyen lnga pa ma pham rdzogs sangs rgyas// byams chen yon tan gter la gus pas 'dud// gang dang gnyis su med pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// dpaṃl gyi 'byung gnas sum ldaṃn rdo rje 'dzin// lung rtogs dam pa'i choṃs kyi rgyal thabs che// mkhas tshul gsum gyis legs par skyoṃng la 'dud// byams chen bstan pa'i snang chen nam 'gyed par// bdag cag 'khor gyi thog mar nyer bstsu nas// theg gsum bdud rtsi yongs bzung mkha' mnyam gyi// 'gro tshogs srid las gdon por byin gyis rlobs// zhes rgyal ba ma pham pa dang mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis su med pa la bstod kyin gsol ba 'debs pa thugs rjer bskul ba'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba 'di ni gser gdung bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis pa'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa ar+tha sid+dhi rastu// ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong tshul khrims rin chen rang nyid bcas la bstod kyin gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyer mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpaṃl stug bstan pa'i 'dab ma brgya ldaṃn tshal// ris bral skye 'gro'i rkang drug yongs bsdus nas// gang 'tsham choṃs tshul sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston gyis// brtse bas skyoṃng ba'i dbang phyug zhabs brtan gsol// kun mkhyen tshulaṃ bzang smra ba'i mchog rnams las// sdom gsum bslab khriṃms legs par nos pa'i sras// phyi nang rig par sbyangs pa'i blo gros kyis// rgyal bstan riṃn cheṃn skyong ba zhabs brtan shog /skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i 'dren pa zung dag la// bsngags pa'i bsod nams sa bon stobs bdo bas// bsam bsgom shes rab myu gu bskyed bsring rtser// don gnyis grub pa'i snye ma g.yur za shog /ces mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong rang nyid bcas la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyer mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas btsun bla ma dkon mchog dpal bzang pa'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༄༅// dpaṃl gyi 'byung gnas stobs bcu ldaṃn pa yi// lung rtogs choṃs kyi 'od snang yongs bzung nas// rnam dag mkhas pa'i bgyi bas skyoṃng ba la// zla bral bstan pa'i nyin byed rgyal gyur cig /dbang bcu ldan pa'i che mchog sngon rabs kyi// smon pa'i lam kun rdzogs min de srid du// bgrang yas bskal par 'tshog zhes bzhugs pa la// gzhan dring 'jog pa med pa'i tshul de dgongs// sdug bsngal kun 'byung chu rlabs kyis g.yengs pas// 'phral yun thar pa'i lam stor lus can tshogs// sgrol byed thugs rje'i zom stegs brling ldan nyid// byams bstan ma shar de srid brtan par bzhugs// bdag cag ltos 'khor bcas pa byang chub bar// ye shes gzigs pa'i gur khyim yangs pa las// 'da' ba med par legs gsungs zil mngar rgyun// thar pa'i bcud du len par byin gyis rlobs// ngag gi rno mtshon grub pa ma lags mod// chos las skyes pa'i bka' 'bangs dad gsum gyis// nyer bskyed de skad gsol btab snye ma dag

/gegs bral g.yur du za bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong ba la zhabs brtan gsol ba bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho pa sku mched rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// stobs bcu'i dpaṃl dang ldaṃn pa rgyal kun gyi// mkhyen dang brtse nus rin chen 'byung gnas las// legs 'khrungs choṃs kyi rgyal thabs skyoṃng ba khyod// gsang gsum rdo rje gsum dngos brtan par bzhugs// brgya phrag bsod nams byed pos bskal pa'i phreng*// mngon par bkra byas dge mtshan rdzogs pa'i sku// gser ri gur gum char gyis bkrus pa bzhin// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i rgyan du brtan par bzhugs// dbyangs kyi yan lag ma tshang med pa'i glur// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi tshul ma lus// rgyan gsum lam nas sems can mos pa bzhin// 'gag med 'doms pa'i dbang phyug brtan par bzhugs// mtha' klas shes bya'i gzugs brgya cig car du// 'char ba'i ngo mtshar mkhyen mtha' ma rtogs skyon// bsgrib phyir kun gsal sprin gos gyon nam snyam// dus gsum gzigs pa chen po brtan par bzhugs// kun rtog tsher ma'i rno dbal mi 'dzin par// sems can mos pa'i shing rta de dang der// bde bar 'gengs pa'i yon tan dpag bsam shing*// bstan 'gro'i spyi nor gcig tu brtan par bzhugs// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi phrin las rgyun// yongs bzung spel la mkhas pa'i ngo mtshar 'dis// gdengs can skyengs te chu gter klong yangs bros// sems can byang chub smin byed brtan par bzhugs// dad blo'i dga' tshal las btus snyan dngags kyi// me tog dkar po'i mchod sprin 'thor ba 'dis// dpal ldan bla ma rab dgyes brtan bzhugs nas// ltos bcas byang chub bar du rjes gzung gsol// skyabs kun 'dus pa khyed kyi thugs rje dang*// dbang bcu ldan pa rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus// ji ltar gsol btab snye ma g.yur za bas// bstan 'gro'i dge legs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes mkhan po chen po rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po par/

sde dge sa skyong bla ma sku mched lha sras rin po che lcam sku 'khor du bcas pas zhabs brtan 'bul ba'i dus su brtan bzhugs me tog dkar po'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong chen po'i bka' lung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas la bsngags pa yid 'phrog rgyags pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ ngaṃg gi dbaṃng phyug mgrin par rnam rtsen pas// blo ldan kuṃn dgaṃ'i dpal bskyed legs bshad gsum// 'dzad pa med pa'i 'byungaṃ gnaṃs lung rtogs kyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan slong ba de la 'dud// theg gsum thos pa'i rtsal rdzogs sred med bus// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug mkha' lding theg par brten// rgyal bstan legs bris lam na thogs med rgyu// mchog gi slob dpon lha brgya'i mgon la 'dud// lhun grub phrin las rgyun ring song ba'i dpe// nga yi bzod snyam lam gsum 'bab kyi rgyun// rgyags pa mi 'tshal stobs bcu mnga' ba yi// phrin las rgyun mi chad pas 'gran gyis dogs// mkhyen brtse nus pa rmad byung rnam par thar// snyan dngags phreng du bstar slad rnam brtags pas// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyod rjes su// nges par snyeg khyod bskal par zhabs brtan gsol// bsngags brjod dpyid kyi yid 'phrog rgyags pa'i glus// gsang gsum byin rlabs dbyar skyes mgron gnyer zhing*// thos bsam bsgom pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za bas// bstan 'gror phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /ces 'dren mchog ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pa la bsngags pa yid 'phrog rgyags pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang nyid mos 'dun yod pa'i steng bka'i slob bu kun dga' phun tshogs pas bskul ba'i 'phral/

ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su bgyis pa rgyal bar gyur cig// / ༄༅// swa sti bi dza yan+tu/ sngon gyi smon lam rjes dran dpyang thag la// byams brtse'i lag pa zung gis legs 'khyud de// bde bar babs pa sprul skur zlos pa'i gar// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i dpal du rgyal gyur cig /legs byas phung po mi shigs rdo rje'i khrir// mnga' gsol rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob dam pa gang*// nyer 'tshe yid srubs dpung las rnam rgyal ba'i// gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin zhabs brtan shog /ye shes khro tshogs srung ba'i gur khyim mdzod// tshe sbyin lha rnams sku tshe'i ka ring tshugs// srung ma'i tshogs kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i don// lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis dge legs stsol// zhes pa thang sgom sprul pa'i sku bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol ba'i tshe/ brtan bzhugs shis brjod 'bul ba'i mtshon byed du rnam byung gi lo'i zla tshes dge bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
